newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply 500 bln won to banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply 500 bln won to banks.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea plans to supply 500 billion won to the banking system through repurchase agreements (Repos) on Wednesday to ease worries over tightening liquidity, an official at the bank said.
Local financial markets have been hit by a shock wave after banks decided on Tuesday to bail out 18 of the Kia Group's 38 affiliates by keeping the credit lines open.
Wednesday's money supply would be on top of one trillion won injected on Tuesday in connection with the Kia Group troubles.
The nation's eighth-largest conglomerate has been struggling under 9.54 trillion won in debts as of the end of May.
Benchmark three-year corporate bond yields were trading at 12.05 percent at midday on Wednesday, up from the previous day's closing rate of 11.95 percent.
